request: Root review and bind a reviewed false-positive disposition if accepted; worker writes no adjudication or hashes.
reason: Statement assumes theta_0 in an open ball U and normalized densities on one fixed support S. Its phrase p_eta(x)>0 exactly when x is in S is a uniform-support hypothesis, not the theorem conclusion. Proof steps 1.1–2.1 handle nonzero increments tending to zero by the segment FTC and domination 2G; steps 3.1–4.1 identify the score expectation and finite coordinate variance. The density cannot have empty essential support; zero H and zero score components are allowed, and d=1 gives the scalar argument. Off S, the density is identically zero on U, so its derivative is zero rather than a division by zero. AC is explicitly inherited for score classes. The conclusion is the one-way differentiability/unbiasedness implication.
